issues.description: The problem statement and UML require Farm.animals to be a List<Animal> (specifically initialized as an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor), but the provided solution implements Farm.animals as a Set<Animal> (HashSet). This type mismatch between the specified collection type and the solution's collection can confuse students about the expected data structure and APIs (e.g., ordering, duplicates, and required imports/signatures).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the specification: change Farm.animals to a List<Animal> and initialize it as an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, update getter/setter and related code accordingly. Alternatively, if Set is intended, update the problem statement and UML to explicitly require a Set and explain the rationale.
